test_cases.title: Following the menu and list links reaches the page that needs an id
acs: DERIVED: Pages that need a record id (customer, participant, contract, scheme, assessment items) are reached by clicking from the menu and lists - 9 paths (data/drill-chains.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: only view links are followed (Details, Participants, Contracts, View, Viewers).

Opening these pages directly without an id is expected to fail (for example PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx throws "CustomerId is required as querystring parameter"), so they are only tested through navigation.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 9 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Click the links of the path in the current row, in order.
steps.expected: Each click opens the next page.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the destination page.
steps.expected: The h1 matches the heading in the row.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from read-only surveys of the running app and the page source; confirm the headings and messages are the intended behaviour.
